candidate.rationale: No meaningful, non‑vacuous postcondition can be added using the public vstd spec vocabulary. The function's only observable contract is that b must hold (already in requires); repeating that as an ensures would merely duplicate the requires. There is no safe way to assert additional properties (termination/purity/state preservation) with available public spec primitives.
risks: Adding ensures b would just duplicate the requires and provide no extra verification value.
Asserting termination or absence of panic would be unsound because the runtime may panic if b is false at runtime.
Specifying memory or resource preservation would require internal/hidden vocab not public in vstd and could be unsound.
